Container.Name: lug-manager
Container.Overview: LUG Manager runs a LEGO User Group (LUG) or other LEGO fan community in one place: members, meetings, shows, check-ins, dues, volunteer shifts, build challenges, inventory and money, with Discord sign-in, announcements and role sync, and Google Calendar/iCal feeds.[br][br] Before installing, create a Discord application and bot (see the project README) and fill in the Discord fields below. On first start the container log prints a one-time /setup?token=... link to create the first admin, then a short setup checklist walks you through the rest.[br][br] Put it behind HTTPS (e.g. a reverse proxy) and set Public URL to that address. Try the demo first: https://arklug.github.io/lug-manager/
Container.Requires: A Discord application with a bot (Server Members Intent on) - see the project README.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, uploaded photos/receipts and daily backups.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people use, e.g. https://lug.example.org (no trailing slash). Used for sign-in redirects and links in emails.

Config.Name: Discord client ID
Config.Description: Discord Developer Portal > your app > OAuth2.

Config.Name: Discord client secret
Config.Description: Discord Developer Portal > your app > OAuth2.

Config.Name: Discord redirect URI
Config.Description: Your Public URL followed by /auth/callback - add the same address in the Developer Portal under OAuth2 redirects.

Config.Name: Discord bot token
Config.Description: Discord Developer Portal > your app > Bot > Reset Token.

Config.Name: First admin's Discord user ID
Config.Description: Optional. This Discord account becomes admin on first sign-in. Otherwise use the one-time /setup link from the container log.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns files in the Data folder (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id that owns files in the Data folder (100 = users).

Config.Name: Discord public key
Config.Description: Optional: resolve duplicate-member matches from Discord buttons (Developer Portal > General Information).

Config.Name: Discord application ID
Config.Description: Optional, with the public key above.

Config.Name: SMTP URL
Config.Description: Optional email for members without Discord, e.g. smtps://smtp.example.org:465 (needs Public URL).
